name: zzop
description: Deterministic repository oracle for AI agents: point it at a repo and get one JSON answer — inventory, dependency graph, per-file risk, and the frontend-call x backend-route join — byte-identical for the same input, with its blind spots named rather than guessed past. TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, Rust, Go, Prisma, SQL natively; anything else via a documented adapter envelope. UPDATES ARE MANUAL for any copy of this bundle installed from a downloaded .mcpb file: Claude Desktop will not offer you a newer version — check https://github.com/eezz4/zzop/releases and re-install the newest .mcpb.
